data.title: SageSure Makes Strategic Investment in Leading Insurance-Linked Securities Fund Manager Pillar Capital Management
data.description: SageSure, a major managing general underwriter specializing in catastrophe-exposed markets, revealed its strategic investment in Pillar Capital Management, a prominent insurance-linked securities fund manager. With Pillar boasting over $4 billion in institutional assets under management, this move adds their superior reinsurance risk underwriting expertise and strong institutional investor connections to the SageSure portfolio.

data.title: KBRA Assigns AA+ Rating to Borough of North Slope, Alaska General Obligation Bonds, Series 2026; Affirms Rating for Parity Bonds
data.description: In a recent announcement, credit rating agency KBRA has assigned a long-term rating of AA+ to the Borough of North Slope, Alaska General Obligation Bonds, Series 2026. Concurrently, KBRA has affirmed the long-term rating of AA+ for the Borough's existing General Obligation Bonds, with a Stable Outlook. The ratings are based on positive factors including the Borough's history of prudent budget management, supported by strong financial management practices. These ratings indicate a high level of creditworthiness for the Borough, positioning it favorably in the bond market.

data.title: Davidson Bogel Signs Two Fortune 100 Logistics Companies at 4226 E. Main Street in Grand Prairie
data.description: In Grand Prairie, Texas, Davidson Bogel Real Estate revealed that two Fortune 100 logistics firms have recently leased a combined space of around 13 acres at 4226 E. Main Street. Acting on behalf of Imperium Capital, Davidson Bogel facilitated the deals without disclosing the tenants' names. The leases cover roughly 3 acres and 10 acres each within the 35-acre site. The property boasts hard-surface parking and a newly installed security guard.
